question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3) i.e. 'integral'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Trees are **essential **to the ecosystem, making them an integral part of the atmosphere.
 
• The word '**integral**' (अनिवार्य) implies **something that is necessary and fundamental**, fitting the context of trees' role in reducing pollution.
 
• '**Integral**' suggests indispensability and crucial importance, aligning with trees' contribution to environmental health.

**Therefore, the correct answer is 'integral'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• '**Trivial**' means of little value or importance.
 
• '**Superficial**' implies existing or occurring at the surface, lacking depth.
 
• '**Petty**' describes something of little significance.

Complete Passage is: Trees are one of the gifts of the nature which are of great importance__ for all living beings and environment. They have __ample__ benefits to living beings providing natural herbs, vegetables, fruits, wood, timber, etc. Trees are the __abode__ of many birds and insects. They are also considered as the __integral__ part of the atmosphere which help in reducing pollution. Conserving trees and spreading awareness to plant trees will save the atmosphere from depletion and ______ survival of all forms on earth.
